default.description: Desktop (NP-151). What the interface of the main window may call besides the app's own commands (NP-019): events, the version, and the window buttons of the frameless window; is-visible (read-only) lets the native tests see the window hidden in the tray. Links open through the app's own command, not the opener plugin.

mobile.description: Phones (NP-151): events and the version. No window buttons: the system draws the app full screen. Back, the edge swipe and the insets go through the koona-mobile plugin's bridge script, which needs no permission. Haptic feedback (NP-072b): the selection tick, impacts and notifications, not free vibration.
